measurement_start: After both managed services first report active, ready and warmup_completed; camera also runs during preparation
workload: One production main, native camera worker and binary WS receiver; both managed speech services resident; explicit stop/retry at 300,600,900,1200,1500 seconds for full run
asr_work: Existing managed service's one-second synthetic silence decode during each initialization; no spoken-WAV transcription or capture pump
tts_work: Existing main preparation generates fixed Chinese and English synthetic warmup text and drains real PCM without playback; validate nonzero per-language receipts
cycle_overrun: Fail if both services cannot return active before the next scheduled cycle or measurement end; never catch up with overlapping retries
acceptance_scope: Coexistence, periodic real warmup, bounded video transport, ownership, cleanup and unchanged protected files; NOT a complete teaching/audio pipeline acceptance
